text:
maya: alert: partner backup bucket s3://partner-backups/2026-03-21 contains objects with base64 strings that match our Vault transit ciphertext pattern. automated rule name: vault-wrap-detector-v2. link: https://alerts.internal/def456
sec-bot: detection: 6 matches, score=0.89, severity=high. recommended: containment + forensic collection. :warning:
raj: don't panic. immediate plan: 1) freeze SA key creation and rotate affected keys 2) create new KMS key version and prepare for rewrap 3) run canary rewrap on single object 4) preserve audit logs + snapshot current KMS key metadata 5) notify partner and legal
olivia: I'll handle the canary and the rewrap tooling. prepping script now. will run only read-only operations until we create the new key version.
obis: (typo in earlier message) meant to say `oncall`
tomas: RBAC: recommend adding a temporary org policy to deny `iam.serviceAccounts.keys.create` from external principals and add a time-bound grant for internal CI to run the rewrap. Also check Cloud Audit Logs for suspicious IPs. Query example: `protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:*
psa-*`
raj: creating new key version now. set protection level to SOFTWARE to match current. will not mark as primary until rewrap completes. will share key resource id when ready.
olivia: canary rewrap command (dry run)
```
# dry run rewrap via vault API
curl -s -X POST "https://vault.internal/v1/transit/rewrap/dry-run" -H "X-Vault-Token: $VAULT_TOKEN" -d '{"ciphertext":"OLD_CT"}'
```

nolivia: canary dry-run shows expected new_ct format. proceeding with live canary after raj posts key id.
raj: new key version created: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/partner-keys/cryptoKeys/backup-wrapping/cryptoKeyVersions/5. do not flip live yet.
olivia: live canary rewrap started on obj-20260321-1. result: success. output:
```
[2026-03-21T23:10:02Z] rewrap ok: s3://partner-backups/2026-03-21/obj-20260321-1 -> new_ct: YmFzZTY0bmV3Cg==
```

olivia: running sweep with rate limit 150/min. posting progress to the incident channel.
sec-bot: incident tagging: INC-2026-03121-BACKUP. export logs to forensic sink.
raj: after sweep completes we'll update Vault transit config to point to the new KMS key version and run smoke tests on ingesters. do not rollback key reference until smoke tests pass.

maya: oncall, please pause deploys that may create SA keys for next 90 minutes. collect list of principals that accessed the bucket in last 72h and upload to incident artifacts.
oncall: ack. pausing deploys and running access log query.

auditor: reminder: keep immutable copies of current Vault key metadata and KMS key versions. we'll need them for the postmortem and compliance evidence. use gs://forensic-archive/INC-2026-03121/metadata.json

raj: sweep done: 6/6 rewrapped successfully. logs at gs://forensic-archive/INC-2026-03121/rewrap.log. avg latency 140ms. starting KMS config flip in 5m.

raj: flipped Vault transit wrapping key to new key version and restarted vault-transit service in canary region. running smoke tests.

olivia: smoke tests passed for canary, running global rollout of vault config. will coordinate with tomas for RBAC followups.

tomas: opened PR for org policy to block external SA key creation and a scoped deny for `iam.serviceAccounts.keys.create`. linking PR: https://git.internal/rp/infra/pulls/274

maya: drafting partner notification now. will include blast radius, actions taken, and recommended rotations on their side. tagging legal for review.

maya: incident owners: raj (KMS + rewrap), olivia (rewrap tooling + logs), tomas (RBAC policy), maya (partner comms + incident doc), auditor (evidence preservation). closing note: we'll schedule a post-incident 1-week follow-up to validate partner rotations and run a config audit. :white_check_mark:
